newsitem.title: CHINA: China forms funeral committee for Deng Xiaoping.
newsitem.headline: China forms funeral committee for Deng Xiaoping.

text.p: China announced it had formed a 459-member funeral committee for paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, who died of respiratory failure on Wednesday.
Deng's anointed successor, Commmunist Party chief and state President Jiang Zemin, was appointed as chairman of the commitee, the Xinhua news agency said.

The formation of the funeral committee is tremendously significant in China's secretive political system, since its composition can identify the leader who will succeed to the supreme power he held until his death.

All members of the 18-man Politburo were on the committee as were two other veterans of China's communist revolution, former president Yang Shangkun, 89, and former parliament chairman Peng Zhen, 95, both close colleagues of Deng and contenders for the mantle of behind-the-scenes kingmaker.
